description:
Ask one question of AI answer engines now; per engine: brand URL cited?, brand named and where, competitors named, cited sources, sentiment. Saved as a citation audit.

Billing: 5–12¢ per engine check — Perplexity 5¢, ChatGPT 7¢, AI Overviews 9¢, Gemini 12¢ (33¢ a prompt on the four defaults), AI Mode 10¢ if asked; only answered checks bill (a repeat within an hour is cached but billed). Then the fix-it playbook get_fix_plan plans from (playbook: false skips it): at most 12¢ per answered check that didn't cite the brand, plus about 45¢ for a rollup when 2+ questions were lost. Default engines: 33¢ + at most 48¢ playbook. dry_run: true quotes it free.

When to call: ask the engines now about one question, or re-check one after a fix. An audit that already ran: get_audit (free); many questions: get_share_of_voice.

Returns { audit_id, report_url (public; give it to the user), results: [{engine, status, brand_mentioned, brand_url_cited, position, competitors, sources, sentiment, was_cache_hit, error_message, answer_excerpt}], citation_rate, completed, total, partial, out_of_credits, charged_cents, charged_breakdown_cents }. Past ~45 s: { audit_id, status: "running", next_step }; it finishes in the background (read with get_audit).

brand.description: Brand as written in prose (e.g. "Linear"). Default: the workspace site's brand.

domain.description: The brand's primary domain (e.g. "linear.app"); matched against cited sources, not fetched. Or pass site_id.

dry_run.description: true: return the price quote (estimated_cents, max_cents, breakdown) and what would run. Nothing runs or bills.

engines.description: Engines to ask. Default: the four core engines; add "ai-mode" for Google AI Mode (10¢/check).

playbook.description: Default true: write the fix-it playbook for checks that don't cite the brand (at most 12¢ each; get_fix_plan plans from it). false: checks only.

prompt.description: The question to ask each engine.

site_id.description: A workspace site (list_sites) instead of domain; fills domain and brand.

name: check_brand_citation
title: Check brand citation across AI engines
